title: THE STACKED-SDSS ANISOTROPY EXECUTION -- the streaming-vs-static test's first data confrontation

upstream.G170: the anisotropy rule beta(2-5 R500) > 0.5 at 3 sigma, sigma_beta <= 0.167; stacked SDSS phase-space already meets the precision; anchors 0.2/0.45/0.7, beta->+1 at R_ta
upstream.G137: the streaming reading (FG secondary infall: beta -> +1 outward)

part1_estimator.name: projected-Jeans anisotropy inversion (Wojtak-class two-asymptote; Diaferio-class stacked phase-space)
part1_estimator.mass_input: NFW M(<r) normalized to M500 inside R500 (caustic class)
steps: projection: sigma_los^2 = (2 int V (1-b R^2/r^2) ...)/(2 int rho ...) x GM500/R500
chi^2 fit (beta_inf, r_a); window beta(2-5 R500)

part2_first_run.data_requirement: cluster catalog (M500/R500) + member galaxies with (R in R500, v_los) to >= 5 R500
part2_first_run.first_providing_stack: HeCS Rines+13 ApJ 767 15 / SDSS DR7 Wojtak & Mamon 2013 MNRAS 428 2407

part3_data.inner: WINGS/HeCS LOS dispersion profiles at 0.5-2 R500 (in-repo wings_spe_cava2009.csv; not to 2-5 R500)

verdicts.V1: executable COMPLETE: estimator, error, scoring rule validated on the committed X-COP set
verdicts.V2: first-run: real beta(2-5 R500) DATA-GATED (no in-repo member (R,v_los) catalog); mock first-run recovers streaming beta_win = 0.637 +- 0.079 (z_null 8.1), null stays at ~0; needs HeCS/DR7 members
verdicts.V3: the streaming envelope's first test is EXECUTABLE today (estimator recovers the injected profile at registered precision); the real beta(2-5 R500) measurement is DATA-GATED on the HeCS/DR7 member catalogs -- the cleanest discriminator between infall and static.
